inputClasses: vrm/gltf GLB (git-tracked conformance fixture; AvatarSample_U when present)
invariants: import copies the hashed bytes into the content-addressed store, writes a preservation/loss report and a ledger entry; a dry run stores nothing
non-GLB bytes as vrm, garbage GLBs, text as png, a nonexistent path and an unknown kind are rejected with the revision unchanged and the ledger empty
a conflicting rights declaration is gateFailed/RIGHTS_CONFLICT
a sidecar is validated: untrusted without a policy, invalid when bound to different bytes or malformed; the import still succeeds while downgrading credentialStatus
a third-party VRM round-trips VRMC_vrm, VRMC_materials_mtoon and VRMC_springBone and preserves unknown extensions opaquely (interoperability)
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass

excluded: conversion to native controls (imported avatars never acquire them)

mutants.description: testImportNonGLBAsVRMIsRejected: non-GLB bytes, garbage, text as png, a missing file and an unknown kind must each be rejected without touching the ledger.
testImportWithConflictingDeclarationFails: an import carrying a declaration whose authors mismatch its meta must be gateFailed/RIGHTS_CONFLICT with revision 0.
testImportWithSidecarReportsCredentialStatus: a sidecar bound to other bytes or malformed must report credentialStatus invalid, never untrusted or valid.
testImportPNGRecordsImageFactsAndDryRunStoresNothing: a dry-run import must write neither a ledger entry nor a blob.

visual.applicabilityRecord: asset import is a hashed copy plus a preservation report and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.
